8.30. iLock_Geography.predicate_library.position¶

The module defines predicate classes that are used to populate geo predicates related to positions of objects.

Classes

NextObject(startUserTypes[, endUserTypes, …]) Predicate class that builds true point ‘(source, dest)’ if dest is the qualified next object of source.
SamePosition([argOrder]) Predicate class that builds true point ‘(obj_1, obj_2)’ if both obj_1 and obj_2 of type INSIDE_TYPE_C are co-located within a node.
